recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. Do not re-add 'partition' as a synonym in the CodeSystemContentMode fragment definition for this seed; any future ValueSet/code-system-fragment behavior changes should follow later fragment tickets once they are Applied or Published.
issue_request: FHIR-18153 was a Published Vocabulary STU3 change request resolved Not Persuasive with Modification. It asked to clarify the codesystem-content-mode fragment definition so it indicated that fragments may also be known as code system partitions, and to add SNOMED CT guidance explaining the partition/fragment use case.
initial_application: Git commit 66ae1e40f1bc02283363c872db14035fc795f8f7 initially applied the issue by adding 'Fragments are also known as partitions' to the historical CodeSystem spreadsheet and by adding SNOMED CT prose about overlapping fragments. The 2021 source rework carried that partition wording into source/codesystem/codesystem-codesystem-content-mode.xml.
additional_context: Later Vocabulary/Terminology review directly revisited the FHIR-18153 interpretation. The 2024 Terminology Fundamentals minutes say FHIR-18153 led to defining fragments as partitions but the group disagreed. The R6 Terminology Content Review records that FHIR-18153 generated an error in the fragment concept description because Code System fragments are not synonymous with partitions, and says the current build fixed it through FHIR-33947. FHIR-33947 was Applied for R6 and replaced the whole fragment definition with the current shorter text. FHIR-35933 separately moved detailed external-code-system guidance, including the old SNOMED CT page, out of FHIR core and into HL7 Terminology.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current build-scope CodeSystemContentMode source matches the later FHIR-33947 decision, and restoring the FHIR-18153 partition synonym would undo a later explicit correction. The old detailed SNOMED CT page text is also no longer a core-source requirement because the authoritative external terminology guidance moved to THO.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 issue deliberately replaced the fragment definition and removed the partition synonym introduced for FHIR-18153. It is already represented on the combined branch.

Published R5 issue moved external-code-system 'Using X with FHIR' pages from core to HL7 Terminology, explaining why the old detailed SNOMED page text should not be restored. It is already represented on the combined branch.
Resolved-change-required issue about ValueSet behavior with CodeSystem fragments relates to FHIR-33947 but is not Applied/Published and was not decided in this default run.
